sources.title: Missouri Secretary of State, Official Election Returns, General Election 2012, results by county (Kansas City listed as its own jurisdiction) (pdf)
Missouri Secretary of State, Official Election Returns, General Election 2012, statewide totals (pdf)

method: Kansas City (Kansas City Board of Election Commissioners, the Jackson County part of the city) U.S. Senator votes transcribed from the official county-by-county returns PDF (text extracted with pdftotext; PDFs kept in data/raw/state/2012_MO_SEN_kc/) into one row added to Jackson County 29095; oth = Dine (Libertarian) 4,814, write-ins 1. Needed because Amlani & Algara's Missouri 2012 U.S. Senator county rows omit Kansas City (statewide shortfall equals Kansas City exactly).
validation: Amlani statewide dem 1,384,027 + KC 110,098 = 1,494,125 vs certified Claire McCaskill 1,494,125: +0 (+0.00%); Amlani statewide rep 1,045,499 + KC 20,660 = 1,066,159 vs certified Todd Akin 1,066,159: +0 (+0.00%). KC row sums to the official KC total of 135,573.
